poll_interval_ms.label: Refresh Interval (ms)
poll_interval_ms.description: How often TachoPulse polls hardware and storage sensors and redraws graphs (500–10000 ms).

bar_gauge_size.label: Bar Graph Size (px)
bar_gauge_size.description: Pixel size for status bar graphs (22–96 px).

desktop_gauge_size.label: Desktop Graph Size (px)
desktop_gauge_size.description: Pixel size for desktop widget gauges (56–160 px).

instance_id.label: Instance ID
instance_id.description: Unique identifier for this widget instance profile (e.g. cpu_temp, disk_free, default).
